verses_he.label: القرار
lines: צַוֵּה וְהַגֵּד מָה תִּרְצֶה, מָה תִּרְצֶה

review: The hymn is the voice of the Beloved: 1:1–4 is Song 2:8 with John 10:3–4, the chorus is John 3:30 (הוּא יִגְדַּל וַאֲנִי אֶקְטָן) with Acts 9:6, 2:1–4 is Ps 23:4 with Song 5:16, and 3:1–4 is Ps 73:26 with Jer 30:17.

The chorus quotes John the Baptist's word 'He must increase' at its head and then turns into address, as the print does with ينبغي أنك تزيد; the Hebrew keeps both the quotation and the shift, so the stanza is first about Him and then to Him.

3:3 כָּל־חַיַּי בְּךָ עָרְבוּ וְיֶעֱרָבוּ — the Arabic كُل عمري فيك طاب ويطيب is 'all my life in You grew sweet and grows sweet'; the Hebrew uses עָרַב in both perfect and imperfect (Ps 104:34), so the line holds the past and the continuing sweetness at once.
